description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans cluster health monitoring system, specifically testing the ClusterHealthMonitor and SiloHealthMonitor functionalities within a distributed Orleans cluster. It verifies behaviors such as periodic silo probing, handling of stale silos, death declaration logic, and responses to different cluster states.

classes.name: ClusterHealthMonitorTests
classes.description: Contains unit tests for verifying the behavior of Orleans cluster health monitoring components, including scenarios involving stale silos, indirect probing, and death declaration conditions.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_BasicScenario
methods.description: Runs a basic test scenario validating the periodic health checks and probe functionalities of the cluster health monitor.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_MonitorAllStaleSilos
methods.description: Tests that stale silos are properly monitored by other silos when configured to do so.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_NoIndirectProbes
methods.description: Verifies cluster health monitoring behavior when indirect probing is disabled.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_ThreeVotesNeededToKill
methods.description: Checks that three votes are required to declare a silo dead.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_OneVoteNeededToKill
methods.description: Verifies that a single vote can declare a silo dead when configured.

methods.name: ClusterHealthMonitor_StaleJoinOrCreatedSilos_Runner
methods.description: Tests the behavior when silos in joining or created state are stale and eviction parameters are enabled or disabled.

methods.name: CreateClusterHealthMonitorTestRig
methods.description: Creates a test rig environment for the cluster health monitor to facilitate detailed scenario testing.

methods.name: StopLifecycle
methods.description: Stops the lifecycle of the cluster health monitor, ensuring all timers are disposed and ongoing tasks are completed.
